text:
matt (oncall): paging oncall — embeddings service is degrading across eu-west. Customers seeing 500s + very high latency. Created incident, severity: P2 for now. Need comms alignment before we post externally.

incident-bot: incident created by matt (oncall) — incident id INC-2026-231, severity=P2, affected: embeddings API (eu-west), alerted: oncall team.

lia (comms): thanks — quick Qs: 1) customer impact wording? 2) do we have ETA for mitigation? 3) who signs off on a tweet vs. status page entry?

matt (oncall): impact = "embedding requests may fail or be significantly delayed (up to ~10s)." No full outages reported, some customers hit higher error rates. Mitigation in progress: rolling restart of the frontend pool + fallback routing to other regions. ETA ~20-40m.

olivia (eng): rolling restart started, tracing shows KV cache thrash when cold starts. We'll monitor error rate while we bring nodes back up. No data leak risk.

lia (comms): ok draft status page entry below. Keep it factual, avoid root cause speculation. We should sync this wording with the tweet and any support note.

lia (comms): ```
Status: Degraded performance and intermittent errors for embeddings API in eu-west.
Impact: Some requests may fail or experience elevated latency.
Workaround: Requests are being routed to healthy replicas where possible; retries recommended.
ETA: Mitigation in progress. Next update in 30 minutes.
```

emily (support): I'll prep a canned reply for customers in affected regions and queue it with priority. Sample: "We're aware of increased errors for embeddings in eu-west; engineers are actively mitigating. Please retry in 20-30 minutes and contact support with request ids if issues persist."

lia (comms): draft tweet (short):

lia (comms): ```
We're investigating elevated errors and latency for our embeddings API in eu-west. Engineers are mitigating — routing and restarts in progress. We'll post updates on status.redwood.com. Sorry for the disruption.
```

matt (oncall): +1 on wording. Important: do not mention "KV cache" or internal implementation in public.

sam (legal): quick flag: avoid naming specific customers or quoting exact error rates. Also avoid promising ETA. "Mitigating" and "updates soon" is safer.

lia (comms): updated tweet per legal: ```
We're investigating elevated errors and latency for the embeddings API in eu-west. Engineers are mitigating; we'll post updates on our status page. Sorry for the disruption.
```

lia (comms): plan: 1) post status page entry now (approved), 2) send support canned reply (emily), 3) publish tweet after 2nd status update or if impact increases (team signoff required). Who signs off tweet now? @matt? @olivia?

matt (oncall): I can sign off for now. If scope changes to multi-region or customers hit high error rate, escalate to R&D lead.

olivia (eng): agree. If we see errors persist after restarts, we'll open a high-severity follow-up and @sam (legal) + @lia in the loop.

lia (comms): posting status update now. Copying exact text from the block above. Will add link to ticket INC-2026-231 and a timeline anchor.

incident-bot: status page updated for INC-2026-231 by lia (comms).

lia (comms): remaining items: - get a quick screenshot of status page for SOC/corp comms - draft customer email if it looks like >1hr impact - prepare a short blog post only if there's a substantive root cause to share (postmortem).

emily (support): canned reply sent to queued tickets. I'll escalate any customers requesting an SLA credit to CS lead and flag here.

matt (oncall): handoff note for next oncall in 30m: ongoing mitigation (rolling restarts), watch for error rate drop below 0.5% and latency back to baseline. If not resolved by handoff, escalate to P1 and loop infra lead.

lia (comms): thanks. I'll hold off on external social until we have a second status update confirming mitigation or a sign-off from matt. For transparency, tweet should reference status.redwood.com (not detailed timeline).

olivia (eng): update: errors trending down after restart; will repost metrics in 10m.

matt (oncall): noted. If trends continue we'll plan a follow-up status update in 15m and then decide on tweet.

lia (comms): ACK. Preparing quick internal comms bundle (status link + approved tweet copy + escalation contacts). Posting to #all-hands-notify once we have second status update.

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-231 severity downgraded to P3 by olivia (eng).

lia (comms): second status update drafted to reflect improvement: ```
Update: Error rates and latency for embeddings API in eu-west are returning to normal after mitigations. Engineers continue to monitor. If you continue to see issues, please contact support with request ids.
```

matt (oncall): signed off on that. Lia, you can post tweet now if you want.

lia (comms): posting tweet and internal comms bundle now. Tweet posted: "We're investigating elevated errors and latency for the embeddings API in eu-west. Engineers mitigated the issue and systems are returning to normal. Status: https://status.redwood.com/inc-2026-231" :thumbsup:

emily (support): customers notified. No SLA credit requests yet.

olivia (eng): monitoring, will keep the incident open until 1hr of stable metrics.

matt (oncall): thanks all. I'll include this incident in our weekly incident roundup and nominate for a follow-up postmortem if root cause requires code changes.

lia (comms): noted — I'll prepare the comms timeline for postmortem draft.

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-231 marked as "monitoring". Next update scheduled in 45m.

matt (oncall): handing off to next oncall @olivia in 10m. Please review the runbook and escalation path.

olivia (eng): will take it."
